english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is less important or significant than another.

exampleSentences.english: This is a minor issue; safety is what matters most.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個係次要問題，最緊要係安全。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ci3 jiu3 man6 tai4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 on1 cyun4

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something subordinate to a primary matter or of lower importance.

exampleSentences.english: These are secondary issues; the most important thing is to treat the patient first.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢啲係次要問題，最緊要係先處理病人。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 ci3 jiu3 man6 tai4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 sin1 cyu2 lei5 beng6 jan4

english.note: Use this when “second” means less important or subordinate rather than numerically ranked second.

exampleSentences.english: These things come second; safety comes first.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢啲嘢係次要嘅，最緊要係安全。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 di1 je5 hai6 ci3 jiu3 ge3 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 on1 cyun4
